card.name: Words leading into a target dose
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as to, a, at, below or recommended that come right before a dose amount or dose name in titration instructions. They follow phrases like "titrated to", "up to", "until" or "increase the dosage".

modes.label: Up to a maximum
modes.description: "to" or "a" ending a phrase about raising the dose to a ceiling.
